English.Char_Desc_2000:
WhenFree is a free, no-login group meeting scheduler - a when2meet-style alternative for finding a time that works for everyone. The event creator shares a link, and each participant marks the times they're available on a shared grid. Availability syncs in real time across all participants via a live backend, so everyone sees updates instantly without refreshing.
WhenFree automatically ranks time slots by how many people are available, so the best overlapping times surface at a glance. Each participant is assigned a distinct color for easy identification on the grid. Once a time is chosen, organizers can add it directly to Google Calendar or download a standard .ics file compatible with Apple Calendar and Outlook.
The app supports both light and dark themes with persistent preference, and is fully localized in English, Hebrew (with right-to-left layout) and French. No sign-up, no app to install, and no cost - just open the link in any modern browser and start scheduling.
